title: Boing! Squeeze & Bounce
short: Squeeze through tight gaps and bounce sky-high. A one-thumb arcade climber.
full:
Press to shrink. Let go to bounce.

Boing! is a one-thumb vertical arcade game. Hold to squeeze your little jelly, drag to line up with the gap, and let go once you are through — the stored energy launches you upward. Hold too long and you pop!

• Simple to learn: press, drag, release
• Every gap is a split-second decision: quick gaps, long gaps and double gaps
• Challenge mode: pure skill, the speed keeps rising
• Growth mode: collect orbs, level up and build combos from 9 abilities, 2 evolutions and risky curses
• Daily challenge: the same course for everyone today, race your own best ghost
• Challenge a friend: send a short link and duel on the exact same course
• Missions and 16 cute skins to unlock with stars
• Five sky zones from dawn to aurora
• Works offline, no account, no ads, no tracking
• Reduce-effects option and vibration control

How high can you bounce?

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
body: Boing! does not collect personal information, does not send any data to servers, and does not share data with anyone.
Your records, settings, stars and skins are stored only on your device. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data deletes them.
There are no accounts, ads, analytics or tracking.

When you send a challenge, the link contains only the course number, your score and the name you chose to enter (optional). It is shared only through the app you pick, such as a messenger, and is never sent to us.
Vibration and sound are used only for game feedback and can be turned off in Settings.
This policy may change when the game changes; the date above will be updated.
